description: This source file defines REST API endpoints for managing dashboard templates, including creation, listing, retrieval, updating, and archiving. It uses FastAPI with dependency injection, interacts with a MongoDB database via Motor, and employs Pydantic models for data validation.

classes.name: TemplateSummaryOut
classes.description: Pydantic model for summarizing template information (id, name, description).

methods.name: create_template( template: TemplateCreateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new dashboard template for the current user, ensuring uniqueness of template_id.

methods.name: list_templates( db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves all non-archived templates owned by the current user.

methods.name: get_template( template_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Fetches a specific template by template_id if owned by the user and not archived.

methods.name: update_template( template_id: str, update: TemplateUpdateEntity, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates fields of a specified template if owned by the user and not archived.

methods.name: archive_template( template_id: str, db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase = Depends(get_database), user=Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Soft-deletes (archives) a user's template by setting is_archived to True.
